name: heytea-doodle-poster
title_zh: 把照片变成喜茶风涂鸦海报或桌面宠物
tagline_zh: 上传一张照片，得到歪扭儿童字+实物加小人的喜茶风海报；或让食物/饮料变成会动、可互动的桌宠。两种玩法，一套技能。
tagline_en: Upload one photo, get a HEYTEA-style poster with wobbly kid-font doodles, or turn food/drinks into an interactive.
desc_en: Turn an uploaded photo into either a HEYTEA-inspired object-and-doodle poster or a personalized hand-drawn desktop pet with approved character concepts, schema-v2 source-faithful actions or schema-v3 flavor-monster behaviors, optional physical interactions, and an importable pet pack. Use for 喜茶简笔画海报, 歪扭儿童字, 实物加小人涂鸦, 桌宠, 照片变桌面宠物, 食物桌宠, or 饮料桌宠.
why_zh: schema-v2 忠实原图动作，schema-v3 放飞风味怪物；还带可导入的宠物包，物理互动可选。
why_en: Schema-v2 stays source-faithful; schema-v3 lets flavor-monsters loose. Optional physical interactions and an importable pet.
limit_zh: 只吃单张照片，不处理多图合成；海报模式仅限静态输出，桌宠需手动导入宠物包；歪扭字仅限中文，英文会变普通字体。
limit_en: Single photo input only; poster mode is static; pet mode needs manual pack import; wobbly font is Chinese-only (English falls back to plain type).
title_en: Turn a photo into a HEYTEA-style doodle poster or desktop.
